reuse.why: Uses existing getSheetValue, setBudget, isTrackingBudget, batchMessages and the undoable/mutator registration, but there is no shared category-selection helper and the diff does not create one.

duplication.why: Copies verbatim the category SELECT (hidden/group-hidden/ui-template filters) and the income-skip loop guard that setZero/set3MonthAvg/set6MonthAvg/set12MonthAvg already each repeat, adding a fifth copy.

placement.why: The action sits in budget/actions.ts next to the other month-wide actions and is registered in budget/app.ts the same way.

scope.why: Only the new action, its handler registration/type and one test.

maintainability.why: Follows the local pattern faithfully, but the 'which categories' rule now lives in five copies that must be kept in sync.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No shared category-selection abstraction exists in the tree; the new action mirrors the existing copies.

disguised_duplication.where: The copied category query and income-skip guard in setLastMonthSpending are verbatim, not disguised.
